title: Operation Vivaldi: how Ukraine cut off russia’s Lyman salient and broke one arm of a pincer on Donbas
lead: Over 145 days, from May to October 2026, Ukraine’s 3rd Army Corps took back 277 km² and 16 settlements north of Lyman, by its own count; the independent DeepState map shows about 155 km². russia had to pull part of a tank army from the Kupiansk front to plug the gap. An interactive 3D map walks through each phase.
imageAlt: Map of Operation Vivaldi: the area north of Lyman with the front line, lines of attack and liberated villages
